about: Conformance vectors for the observed-effect evidence document, v4 (G6: v3 with dispatch.verified holding exactly four fields -- approvals_digest and workflow_approval as v3; tool_contract, the contract {kind, identifier, digest} the gate verified for the dispatched tool from its dispatch re-read of the approval in force (null when the link is off or the permit names no chain), whose kind and identifier are the document's tool; and approval_recipients, the permit's approval-recipient entries {obligation, approval, recipient, destination, tenant} with the nonce left out, sorted by those five fields in that order (compared as text, a null as the empty string), never by the permit's MAC order, which is keyed by the nonce; a bound entry's destination and tenant are text (empty allowed), an unbound entry's both null; every text field at most 200 characters and the list at most 100 entries; [] when the permit rests on no approvals), generated from achilles-engine (achilles/observed_effect.py, achilles/action_gate.py, achilles/workflow_approval.py, achilles/api/decisions.py) and carried byte-for-byte in athena-backend. inputs.approval_in_force is the answer of athena-backend's approval-in-force route to ?include=tools the decide's reading and the permit's approved_tools were made from, and inputs.approval_in_force_at_dispatch the same route's answer to the dispatch's re-read. inputs.permit lists its approval recipients in neither order; its MAC sorts them by nonce, the document by its five fields, and the two differ here. Each key is Ed25519 with the private seed SHA-256 of its phrase: test keys, public by construction, never a real one. Keys, payloads and signatures are written as hex; an envelope's base64 fields are the base64 of those bytes.
effect_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v4 conformance vector: the observed-effect test key, never a real one
gate_key_phrase: mythos.observed-effect/v4 conformance vector: the gate's outcome test key, never a real one
